messages:
olivia_support: heads up — acme-prod (acct: acme-prod) opened a support ticket: p99 latency jumped ~+2.4s after the kite-v2 model swap at 12:07 UTC. Affects long-context endpoints (requests >~8k tokens). They see tokenization step stall repeatedly. request-id=req_0a1b2c

deploy-bot: Deployed model kite-v2 to region us-west-2 at 2024-11-18T12:07:21Z by ops/rohit

chris_eng-ml: ack. can you paste a sample payload + request-id? note: kite-v2 onboarding included a new bpe/tokenizer variant (bpe-v2) and an extra unicode normalization pass — could be slow for CJK-heavy inputs

olivia_support: sample below (redacted). request-id=req_0a1b2c. payload contains a long transcript with mixed CJK + emoji. snippet: "这是一个很长的文档..." — client says p99 aligns with tokenization timestamp in their logs

henry_runtime: I pulled traces for req_0a1b2c. Tokenizer container CPU spikes right at start; p95 CPU > 90% on the tokenization pod and we see repeated calls into the slow normalization fallback. Latency flame shows a ~2s block before any model tokens generated

henry_runtime: quick repro (use their payload):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"kite-v2","input":"<long_cjk_document_here>","max_tokens":1024}'
```

chris_eng-ml: that reproduces locally for me with a CJK-heavy file. behavior: bpe-v2 enters slow normalization path for certain unicode sequences and then falls back to per-char handling. Not a runtime kernel issue, it's in tokenizer logic (normalization + regexes)

chris_eng-ml: mitigation options: 1) immediate rollback to kite-v1 for affected regions/customers, 2) route long-context customers to a fallback route (kite-v1), 3) quick patch to skip heavy normalization for inputs > 4k tokens or when language detection strongly indicates CJK (fast-path). I recommend rollback first to stop customer impact

kevin_pm: any customer billing or auth fallout? acme reported some timed-out requests billed as errors, worried about cost noise. CS: tell client we're rolling back and will credit noisy calls if needed

olivia_support: told client we can rollback now or enable fallback routing. they prefer rollback and credit offer. they want ETA on root cause and fix

rohit_ops: initiating rollback for us-west-2 now.

deploy-bot: Rolling back kite-v2 -> kite-v1 in us-west-2 (triggered by ops/rohit) at 2024-11-18T12:28:09Z

henry_runtime: post-rollback monitoring: p99 for the affected fleet dropped back to baseline within ~10m. CPU normalized and tokenization time removed the 2s stall window.

chris_eng-ml: I'll file a follow-up ticket for the tokenizer team (TK-4321) with repro, sample payloads, and perf traces. proposed long-term fixes: revert bpe-v2 normalization changes until we harden, add a synthetic long-CJK perf test in the onboarding pipeline, and add a perf gate (p99 <= +5% vs baseline) for model swaps

olivia_support: client updated and offered credits. closing immediate escalation. scheduling postmortem with eng, runtime, and support for tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

rohit_ops: note for runbook — add quick rollback checkbox for model-swaps and a preflight perf smoke for >4k token inputs.

chris_eng-ml: agreed. I'll also add a temporary runtime flag to route >8k token requests to fallback until tokenizer patch is in place.

olivia_support: thanks team — marking support ticket as resolved pending postmortem
